name: Vibeprint Studio
description:
Vibeprint Studio is an open-source 3D printing slicing and printer management application. It streamlines preparing 3D models (STL, OBJ, 3MF) for fabrication with intuitive slicing controls and G-code generation.

Features:
- High-performance slicing engine generating optimized toolpaths and supports
- Visual 3D layer preview inspecting nozzle trajectories and travel speeds
- Direct network printing integration for Moonraker, Klipper, and OctoPrint
- Multi-material printing support and customizable filament profiles
- Clean, modern desktop interface designed for makers and 3D printing professionals
